_note: Batch 18: ten REAL Perth natural & alternative therapy providers researched from public information on 11 Aug 2026, covering the requested subtypes — ayurveda (2), TCM/acupuncture (2), naturopathy with iridology, herbal medicine + homeopathy, flower essences, aromatherapy, and nutritional therapy. Zero overlap with the 20 natural listings already in the directory, checked by name and domain. aromatherapy and flower-essences were added to the specialty map in the same commit. TGA discipline at its strictest here: homeopathy and TCM copy names services and formats only — several of these sites publish long condition lists (fertility, anxiety, long COVID) and NONE of that is repeated; Ayurvedic practitioner registrations are named because they are verifiable facts. Dropped during verification: Amor Aromatherapy (New Zealand business, not Perth), Polly Clinic (broken SSL, site effectively down), Ayur Healthcare (Sydney-based telehealth page), healthynaturopath.com.au (unreachable), Margaret Liu Canning Vale (directory-only, no site). New suburbs: Landsdale and Padbury (north), Coolbinia (central), Leeming (freo), Lesmurdie (hills), Mount Nasura (southeast), Morley (central).

categories.name: Natural & Alternative Therapies
categories.blurb: Naturopaths, herbalists, homeopaths, Chinese medicine, Ayurveda and acupuncture.

categories.name: Dietitians & nutrition
categories.blurb: Accredited practising dietitians and nutrition support, in clinic and by telehealth.

listings.name: Aura Ayurveda
listings.blurb: Kerala-trained Ayurveda in Perth's north: Ann holds a Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery from Government Ayurveda College Kannur, is registered with the Australasian Association of Ayurveda, and works as a mental health clinician besides. Consultations, abhyanga and shirodhara treatments, panchakarma programs and customised herbal preparations, seven days by appointment.
listings._source: auraayurveda.com.au — Yellowstone Street address, practitioner's BAMS degree and AAA registration, service list, seven-day appointment model, phone and email published. Their specialty condition list deliberately not repeated

listings.name: Ayurveda Awareness Centre
listings.blurb: Neerja Ahuja's Applecross centre pairs classical Ayurvedic treatment — snehana herbal-oil massage, nasya, purvakarma and panchakarma programs — with diet and lifestyle sessions and yoga nidra. A long-established practice on the south side of the river with consultations and treatments booked separately.
listings._source: ayurveda-awareness.com.au — Cunningham Street address, practitioner, treatment menu incl. yoga nidra, phone and email published; prices via their booking pages

listings.name: TCM Health Care
listings.blurb: Kimberley Zhang's Leeming clinic, running since 2012 with an unusual house rule: every practitioner must have at least ten years' clinical experience beyond their degree and registration. Acupuncture, Chinese herbal medicine, tui-na meridian massage, cupping and combination acupuncture-remedial sessions, with telehealth consults and HICAPS rebates.
listings._source: tcmhealthcare.com.au — Farrington Road address, 2012 founding, ten-year practitioner minimum, service list, phone and HICAPS published. Their fertility/long-COVID condition list deliberately not repeated

listings.name: TCM Acupuncture Perth
listings.blurb: A North Perth Chinese medicine clinic covering acupuncture, electroacupuncture, cosmetic acupuncture, herbal medicine, cupping and moxibustion, with dietary advice from the TCM frame. Open Tuesday to Saturday with evening slots to 7pm on weekdays, booked online or by phone.
listings._source: tcmacupunctureperth.com — Daphne Street address, service list, Tue–Sat hours, phone and Setmore booking published; practitioner name not shown on the page

listings.name: Silverdale Holistic Therapy
listings.blurb: Tracy O'Meara Smith works from the Perth Hills with flower essences at the centre of the practice — personalised blends drawn from West Australian, Australian bush, Bach and FES ranges, flower affinity readings, and Baihui sessions that pair essence work with Bowen bodywork at $250 including the take-home blend. A free fifteen-minute consult opens the door.
listings._source: silverdale.com.au — practitioner, Perth Hills (Kalamunda/Lesmurdie) location, essence ranges, $250 Baihui session with published inclusions, free intro consult, online booking confirmed

listings.name: Rose and Sage Natural Health Clinic
listings.blurb: Catherine Angel has practised Western herbal medicine, homeopathy and naturopathy from the southern hills since 2007, with a dispensary side making creams, teas and made-to-order homeopathic kits. Consultations run 90 minutes initially at $140, follow-ups $85, with 30-minute acute appointments at $45 and discounts for unwaged clients — open weekday evenings to 8pm.
listings._source: roseandsage.com.au — practitioner, Mount Nasura location, 17 years' practice, full published fee schedule incl. unwaged discounts, evening hours, phone confirmed. Kit purposes described as formats, not treatment claims

listings.name: David Adler Naturopath
listings.blurb: Over twenty years of naturopathic practice from Morley, combining iridology assessment with herbal medicine, homeopathy and broader naturopathic consultation — a classic single-practitioner natural medicine clinic in Perth's north-east.
listings._source: davidadlernaturopath.com — practitioner name and credentials (NDDAr mATMS), Morley base, 20+ years, service list confirmed; his health-area list deliberately not repeated. Contact via site form only

listings.name: Eclipse Living Essence Aromatherapy
listings.blurb: Joanne Lang has taught and practised aromatherapy for over thirty years — trained in London in 1992, IFA-accredited as a teacher in 1996, and accredited at Advanced Practitioner Level III with the Alliance of International Aromatherapists. The practice spans aromatherapy and remedial massage, custom blending, workshops from skincare to pregnancy, and a full Diploma of Clinical Aromatherapy for those learning the craft.
listings._source: aromatherapywa.com.au — practitioner's 30-year history with London/IFA/AIA credentials and dates, service and training menu, phone and email published; Coolbinia location from their public listings

listings.name: Moved by Wellness
listings.blurb: Flavia Giardino practises clinical nutrition from Padbury with a Bachelor of Health Sciences in Nutrition and Dietetic Medicine — education-first nutritional therapy across gut health, women's health, plant-based and family nutrition, built on personalised plans rather than handed-down meal sheets. A free discovery call starts things off.
listings._source: movedbywellness.com.au — practitioner, Padbury base, degree credential, practice areas, consultation model, phone and email published; prices not listed

listings.name: Life Line Ayurveda Centre
listings.blurb: An Ayurvedic centre serving Perth with consultations and customised plans built around classical herbal preparations and diet recommendations — part of the Life Line herbal group, with treatments arranged around the individual consultation rather than a fixed menu.
listings._source: lifelineherbal.com.au — Ayurvedic consultation and herbal model from their published Perth pages; suburb and prices not confirmed, entry kept minimal. SEARCH-LEVEL verification, worth a manual check before publishing
